feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: SCOTUS allows Trump's ballroom project to continue. And, the Army secretary resigns
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that President Trump's ballroom project may continue. And, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns after 18 months on the job.

entry.title: Global finance ministers gather in North Carolina for G20 summit
entry.summary: The U.S. is playing host to finance ministers from around the world this week. Russia's top economic official made a stir on Monday when he showed up in person at the meeting in North Carolina.

entry.title: The U.S. wants others to join its economic pressure campaign against Iran. Will they?
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former Deputy National Security Adviser Jon Finer about U.S. efforts to cultivate global support to economically isolate and pressure Iran.

entry.title: Days after Trump announces Venezuela oil deal, White House fills in some of the details
entry.summary: As part of the deal, the U.S. is creating a private company as a joint venture with North American Blue Energy Partners, owned by Venezuelan businessman Alejandro Betancourt.

entry.title: Hindu pilgrims on an arduous trek are among Nepal's missing
entry.summary: Among the hundreds still missing on Nepal's border with China are Hindus from India and beyond, participating in a journey of devotion to a sacred mountain.

entry.title: Trump's plan for economic D-day for Iran has one big hole: China
entry.summary: The Trump administration says it's asking countries to voluntarily cut off business with Iran to squeeze its economy further. But the most critical country — China — already says it won't cooperate.

entry.title: Lionel Messi says he's retiring from playing internationally for Argentina
entry.summary: The soccer star is ending 21 years of Argentine national-team duty but will continue to play at club level with Inter Miami in U.S. Major League Soccer.

entry.title: Nepal's hesitance to accept foreign help for flood relief comes under scrutiny
entry.summary: A group of the country's private sector power producers says Nepali authorities lost crucial time in rescuing hundreds of people trapped in hydropower tunnels.

entry.title: U.S., Venezuela strike oil deal. And, the staggering hidden toll of U.S. heat deaths
entry.summary: The U.S. and Venezuela have entered into an oil deal. And, NPR spent two years tracking heat-related deaths and found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat more than the official counts show.

entry.title: Russia's jet-powered drones bring empty Kyiv supermarket shelves and rattle Ukrainians
entry.summary: Russian forces relentlessly battered Kyiv and cities in the region around the Ukrainian capital for a fifth straight day, leaving some supermarket shelves bare after repeated strikes on warehouses.
